sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，幸稻田莊。

translations.literal: Second month, wuxu: the Emperor visited the Rice Field Estate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the second month Mingzong visited the Rice Field Estate.

sentences.zh: 己亥，黑水國主兀兒遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On jihai, the lord of the Heishui state Wu'er sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the Heishui ruler Wu'er sent tribute envoys with local products.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士劉煦奏：「新學士入院，舊試五題，請今後停試詩賦，隻試麻製、答蕃書、批答共三道。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician Liu Xu memorialized: "When new academicians enter the institute, the old test had five topics; it is requested that hereafter poetry and rhapsody be stopped, and only three topics be tested—draft edicts, replies to foreign letters, and rescripts in all.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin academician Liu Xu asked that new fellows drop poetry and rhapsody from the five-topic entrance exam and test only edict drafts, foreign letters, and rescripts.

sentences.zh: 仍請內賜題目，定字數，付本院召試。

translations.literal: It is further requested that topics be granted from within, word counts fixed, and the institute be charged to summon the test.
translations.idiomatic: He wanted court-set topics and word limits and tests summoned by the Hanlin Institute.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》載劉煦原奏云：「舊例學士入院，除中書舍人不試，餘官皆先試麻製、答蕃、批答各一道，詩賦各一道，號曰五題，並於當日呈納。

translations.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 records Liu Xu's original memorial saying: "By old rule when academicians enter the institute, except for Secretariat drafters who are not tested, all other offices are first tested on one topic each of draft edicts, replies to foreigners, and rescripts, and one topic each of poetry and rhapsody, called the five topics, all to be submitted the same day.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 quotes Liu Xu: entrants except Secretariat drafters faced five same-day topics—edict drafts, foreign replies, rescripts, poetry, and rhapsody.

sentences.zh: 從前每遇召試，多預出五題，潛令宿構，其無黨援者，即日起草，罕能成功。

translations.literal: Whenever a summoned test occurred in the past, the five topics were often leaked in advance and candidates secretly made to prepare overnight; those without factional backing had to draft on the spot and rarely succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Leaked topics let favorites prepare overnight while outsiders drafted on the spot and rarely passed.

sentences.zh: 今請權停詩賦，隻試三道，仍內賜題目，兼定字數。

translations.literal: Now it is requested to suspend poetry and rhapsody for the time being and test only the three topics, still with topics granted from within and word counts fixed.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to drop poetry and rhapsody, test only the three prose topics, and keep court-set limits.

translations.literal: 」It was approved.)〉
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.)〉

sentences.zh: 有司奏：「皇帝致齋於明堂，按舊服通天冠、絳紗袍，文武五品已上著袴褶，近例隻著朝服。

translations.literal: The relevant offices memorialized: "When the Emperor performs fasting at the Bright Hall, by old custom he wears the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe, and civil and military officials of fifth rank and above wear trousers and jackets; in recent practice only court dress is worn.
translations.idiomatic: Offices said Mingtang fasting should restore the Tongtian crown and crimson robe for the emperor and trousers and jackets for fifth-rank officials, not only court dress.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，中書奏：「皇帝朝獻太微宮、太廟，祭天地於圜丘，準禮例親王為亞獻行事，受誓戒。

translations.literal: On yisi, the Secretariat memorialized: "When the Emperor offers at the Supreme Palace of the Purple Subtlety and the Grand Shrine, and sacrifices to Heaven and Earth at the Round Mound, by ritual precedent imperial princes serve as secondary offerers, perform the rites, and receive the abstention oath.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the secretariat said princes should again serve as secondary offerers at the Supreme Palace, Grand Shrine, and Round Mound sacrifices and take the abstention oath.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 以天雄軍節度使石敬瑭為御營使。

translations.literal: Tianxiong army military commissioner Shi Jingtang was made imperial camp commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Jingtang of Tianxiong became imperial camp commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬子，帝宿齋於明堂殿。

translations.literal: On renzi, the Emperor lodged in fasting at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Mingzong fasted at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，朝獻太微宮。

translations.literal: On guichou, he offered at the Supreme Palace of the Purple Subtlety.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he offered at the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 是日，宿齋於太廟。

translations.literal: That day he lodged in fasting at the Grand Shrine.
translations.idiomatic: That day he fasted at the Grand Shrine.

sentences.zh: 詰旦，請行饗禮。

translations.literal: At dawn he requested to perform the feast rite.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn he began the feast rite.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，赴南郊齋宮。

translations.literal: On jiayin, he went to the southern suburb fasting palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he entered the southern suburb fasting palace.

sentences.zh: 是夜微雨，三鼓後晴明如晝。

translations.literal: That night there was light rain; after the third watch it cleared bright as day.
translations.idiomatic: Light rain fell that night, then after the third watch the sky cleared bright as day.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，祀昊天上帝於圜丘，柴燎禮畢，郊宮受賀。

translations.literal: On yimao, he sacrificed to the Supreme Lord of Heaven at the Round Mound; when the firewood offering was finished, congratulations were received at the suburban palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he sacrificed to Heaven at the Round Mound, and after the firewood offering the suburban palace received congratulations.

sentences.zh: 是日，禦五鳳樓，宣製：改天成五年為長興元年；

translations.literal: That day he took the Five Phoenix Tower and proclaimed a rescript: the fifth year of Tiancheng is changed to the first year of Changxing;
translations.idiomatic: That day at the Five Phoenix Tower he proclaimed the era change from Tiancheng 5 to Changxing 1;

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，除十惡五逆、放火劫舍、屠牛、官典犯贓、偽行印信、合造毒藥外，罪無輕重，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: a great amnesty for the realm, excepting the ten abominations and five rebellions, arson and robbery, slaughtering cattle, official corruption, forging seals, and compounding poison—all crimes light or heavy are pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: and a great amnesty excepting the ten abominations, five rebellions, arson, robbery, cattle slaughter, official corruption, forged seals, and poison-making.

sentences.zh: 天成四年終諸道所欠殘稅及場院欠折，並特放免。

translations.literal: Outstanding residual taxes and market shortfalls owed by every circuit at the end of Tiancheng 4 were specially remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Residual taxes and market debts from Tiancheng 4 were remitted in every circuit.

sentences.zh: 群臣職位帶平章事、侍中、中書令，並與改鄉名裏號。

translations.literal: Ministers whose posts carried Grand Councillor, Attendant-in-Chief, or Secretariat Director were all given changed native district and lane names.
translations.idiomatic: Grand councillors, attendants-in-chief, and secretariat directors received new native place names.

sentences.zh: 朝臣及蕃侯郡守亡父母，及父母在並妻室未沾恩命者，並與恩澤。

translations.literal: Court officials and tribal frontier governors whose parents had died, or whose parents were alive together with wives not yet favored by grace, were all granted favor.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and tribal governors with deceased parents or living parents and unfavored wives received amnesty favors.

sentences.zh: 應私債出利已經倍者，隻許征本；

translations.literal: On private debts whose interest had already doubled the principal, only the principal may be collected;
translations.idiomatic: Private debts whose interest had doubled principal could collect only principal;

sentences.zh: 已經兩倍者，本利並放。

translations.literal: where interest had already reached twice the principal, both principal and interest are remitted.
translations.idiomatic: where interest reached twice the principal, both were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 河陽管內人戶，每畝舊征橋道錢五文，今後不征。

translations.literal: For households within Heyang circuit, the old bridge and road levy of five cash per mu is hereafter not collected.
translations.idiomatic: Heyang's old five-cash-per-mu bridge levy was abolished.

sentences.zh: 諸道州府每畝先征曲錢五文，今特放二文雲。

translations.literal: For every prefecture in every circuit the former levy of five cash per mu in miscellaneous fees is specially reduced by two cash."
translations.idiomatic: Every circuit prefecture's five-cash miscellaneous levy per mu was cut by two cash."

sentences.zh: 商州吏民以刺史郭知瓊善政聞，詔褒之。

translations.literal: Shang prefecture officials and people reported that prefect Guo Zhiqiong's good government was heard of; an edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Shang reported prefect Guo Zhiqiong's good rule and Mingzong praised him.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，幸會節園，遂幸河南府。

translations.literal: Third month, dingmao: he visited the Festival Garden and then visited Henan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the third month Mingzong visited the Festival Garden and then Henan.

sentences.zh: 靈武奏，殺戮蕃賊二千人。

translations.literal: Lingwu memorialized that two thousand frontier tribesmen were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Lingwu reported killing two thousand frontier tribesmen.

sentences.zh: 壬申，鳳翔節度使李從嚴進封岐國公，移鎮汴州。

translations.literal: On renshen, Fengxiang military commissioner Li Congyan was advanced to Duke of Qi and transferred to Bian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Li Congyan of Fengxiang became Duke of Qi and moved to Bian.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，延州節度使高允韜移鎮邢州。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Yanan military commissioner Gao Yuntao was transferred to Xing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Gao Yuntao of Yanan moved to Xing.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以宣徽使朱宏昭為鳳翔節度使；

translations.literal: On bingzi, Palace Intendant Zhu Hongzhao was made Fengxiang military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Zhu Hongzhao became Fengxiang commissioner;

sentences.zh: 潞州節度使朱漢賓加檢校太傅，移鎮晉州；

translations.literal: Lu prefecture military commissioner Zhu Hanbin was given added Inspector Grand Mentor and transferred to Jin prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hanbin of Lu received inspector grand mentor rank and moved to Jin;

sentences.zh: 徐州節度使房知溫移鎮鄆州；

translations.literal: Xuzhou military commissioner Fang Zhiwen was transferred to Yan prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Fang Zhiwen of Xu moved to Yan;

sentences.zh: 鄆州節度使王晏球移鎮青州。

translations.literal: Yan prefecture military commissioner Wang Yanqiu was transferred to Qing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: and Wang Yanqiu of Yan moved to Qing.

sentences.zh: 宰臣馮道率百僚拜表，請上尊號曰聖明神武文德恭孝皇帝，詔報不允。

translations.literal: Chancellor Feng Dao led the hundred officials in a memorial begging that the honorific title Sagely Illumined, Divinely Martial, Cultured in Virtue, and Reverently Filial Emperor be granted; an edict replied that it was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Dao and the officials asked for the title Sagely Illumined, Divinely Martial, Cultured, and Reverently Filial; Mingzong refused.

sentences.zh: 壬午，許州節度使孔循移鎮滄州；

translations.literal: On renwu, Xu prefecture military commissioner Kong Xun was transferred to Cang prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Kong Xun of Xu moved to Cang;

sentences.zh: 陝州節度使張延朗移鎮許州，加檢校太傅；

translations.literal: Shaan prefecture military commissioner Zhang Yanlang was transferred to Xu prefecture and given added Inspector Grand Mentor;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanlang of Shaan moved to Xu with inspector grand mentor rank;

sentences.zh: 滄州節度使張虔釗移鎮徐州，加檢校太保。

translations.literal: Cang prefecture military commissioner Zhang Qianzhao was transferred to Xu prefecture and given added Inspector Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: and Zhang Qianzhao of Cang moved to Xu with inspector grand guardian rank.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔貶右散騎常侍、集賢殿學士、判院事蕭希甫為嵐州司戶參軍，仍馳驛發遣，坐誣告之罪也。

translations.literal: On guiwei, an edict demoted Right Regular Cavalier, Hall of Assembled Worthies academician, and acting director of the institute Xiao Xifu to Lan prefecture registrar, still ordering dispatch by urgent relay, sitting for the crime of false accusation.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Xiao Xifu was demoted to Lan registrar and rushed into exile for false accusation.

sentences.zh: 宰臣馮道等再請上尊號，詔允之。

translations.literal: Chancellor Feng Dao and others again begged the honorific title; an edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Dao and others asked again for the honorific title and Mingzong approved.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使、河陽節度使康義誠為襄州節度使、檢校太傅；

translations.literal: On bingxu, commander-in-chief of the Palace Guard personal army and horse-and-foot forces and Heyang military commissioner Kang Yicheng was made Xiang prefecture military commissioner and Inspector Grand Mentor;
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Kang Yicheng of the palace guard and Heyang became Xiang commissioner and inspector grand mentor;

sentences.zh: 以左武衛上將軍劉彥琮為陝州節度使、檢校太保。

translations.literal: Left Martial Guard senior general Liu Yancong was made Shaan prefecture military commissioner and Inspector Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: and Liu Yancong became Shaan commissioner and inspector grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，製淑妃曹氏可立為皇后，仍令擇日冊命。

translations.literal: On gengyin, a rescript made Pure Consort Cao of the Shufei rank establishable as empress, still ordering a day chosen for investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Pure Consort Cao was named empress with investiture to follow on a chosen day.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午朔，國子司業張溥奏，請復八館，以廣生徒。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jiawu new moon: National University vice director Zhang Pu memorialized, requesting restoration of the eight halls to expand students.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu new moon of the fourth month university vice director Zhang Pu asked to restore eight halls to expand enrollment.

sentences.zh: 按《六典》，監有六學，國子、太學、四門、律學、書學、算學是也，而溥雲八館，謬矣。

translations.literal: According to the 《Six Codes》, the directorate had six schools—National University, Grand Academy, Four Gates, Law, Calligraphy, and Mathematics—and yet Pu spoke of eight halls, which is erroneous.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Six Codes》 lists six schools, so Zhang Pu's "eight halls" was wrong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，前汴州節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中符習加太子太師致仕，進封衛國公。

translations.literal: On dingyou, former Bian prefecture military commissioner, Inspector Grand Guardian, and concurrent Attendant-in-Chief Fu Xi was advanced to Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent with retirement and advanced to Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Fu Xi of Bian retired as grand mentor of the heir apparent and Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，遂州節度使夏魯奇加同平章事，皇子河中節度使從珂進位檢校太尉，封開國公。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Suizhou military commissioner Xia Luqi was given concurrent Grand Councillor; the prince and Hedong military commissioner Congke was advanced to Inspector Grand Guardian and enfeoffed Duke of the State.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Xia Luqi of Suizhou became grand councillor and Prince Congke of Hedong became inspector grand guardian and state duke.

sentences.zh: 自是諸道節鎮皆次第加恩，以郊禋覃慶澤故也。

translations.literal: From this time every circuit military commissioner was advanced in turn with favor, because of the suburban sacrifice's spreading of celebratory grace.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter every commissioner received suburban-sacrifice favors in turn.

sentences.zh: 己亥，幸會節園。

translations.literal: On jihai, he visited the Festival Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Mingzong visited the Festival Garden.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以樞密使安重誨為留守、太尉、兼中書令，使如故。

translations.literal: On renyin, Privy Commissioner An Chonghui was made regent, Grand Guardian, and concurrent Secretariat Director, with envoy duties as before.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin An Chonghui became regent, grand guardian, and secretariat director while keeping his privy post.

sentences.zh: 青州節度使王建立加侍中，移鎮潞州。

translations.literal: Qing prefecture military commissioner Wang Jianli was given Attendant-in-Chief and transferred to Lu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jianli of Qing received attendant-in-chief rank and moved to Lu.

sentences.zh: 皇子河中節度使從珂奏：「臣今月五日，閱馬於黃龍莊，衙內指揮使楊彥溫據城叛，臣尋時詰問，稱奉宣命。

translations.literal: The prince and Hedong military commissioner Congke memorialized: "On the fifth of this month, while I was inspecting horses at Yellow Dragon Estate, yamen commander Yang Yanwen seized the city in rebellion; I immediately questioned him, and he said he was acting on a proclamation order.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Congke of Hedong reported that on the fifth, while inspecting horses at Yellow Dragon Estate, commander Yang Yanwen rebelled and seized the city, claiming a proclamation order.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （胡三省《通鑒注》云：樞密院用宣，三省用堂帖。）〉

translations.literal: (Hu Sansheng's 《Zizhi Tongjian · Commentary》 says: The Bureau of Military Affairs uses proclamations; the Three Departments use hall posts.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Hu Sansheng's 《Zizhi Tongjian · Commentary》 says the privy council used proclamations and the three departments hall posts.)〉

sentences.zh: 臣見在虞鄉縣。

translations.literal: I am now at Yuxiang county.
translations.idiomatic: Congke was then at Yuxiang county.

sentences.zh: 」帝遣西京留守索自通、侍衛步軍都指揮使藥彥稠等攻之，仍授彥溫絳州刺史，冀誘而擒之也。

translations.literal: 」The Emperor dispatched Western Capital regent Suo Zitong, commander-in-chief of the Palace Guard foot army Yao Yanchou, and others to attack him, still appointing Yanwen prefect of Jiang prefecture, hoping to lure and capture him.
translations.idiomatic: 」Mingzong sent Suo Zitong, Yao Yanchou, and others against him while naming Yanwen Jiang prefect to lure his surrender.

sentences.zh: 詔從珂赴闕。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Congke to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong ordered Congke to court.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以戶部尚書李鈴為兗州行軍司馬，坐引淮南覘人貽安重誨寶帶也。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Minister of Revenue Li Ling was made Yan prefecture campaign adjutant, sitting for having given An Chonghui a jeweled belt through a Huainan spy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Li Ling became Yan campaign adjutant for bribing An Chonghui through a Huainan spy.

sentences.zh: 戊申，宰臣馮道加右僕射，趙鳳加吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On wushen, Chancellor Feng Dao was given Right Vice Director; Zhao Feng was given Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Feng Dao became right vice director and Zhao Feng personnel minister.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以左龍武統軍劉君鐸卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On yiyou, court was suspended because Left Dragon Martial commander-in-chief Liu Junduo had died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou court was canceled for the death of Liu Junduo of the Left Dragon Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，索自通、藥彥稠等奏，收復河中，斬楊彥溫，傳首來獻。

translations.literal: On guichou, Suo Zitong, Yao Yanchou, and others memorialized that Hedong had been recovered, Yang Yanwen beheaded, and his head sent in offering.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Suo Zitong and Yao Yanchou reported recovering Hedong, beheading Yang Yanwen, and sending his head.

sentences.zh: 初，彥稠出師，帝戒之曰：「與朕生致彥溫，吾將自訊之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Yanchou marched out, the Emperor warned him: "Bring Yanwen alive to me—I will question him myself.
translations.idiomatic: Before the march Mingzong told Yanchou to bring Yanwen alive for questioning.

sentences.zh: 」及收城，斬首傳送，帝怒彥稠等。

translations.literal: 」When the city was taken, the head was cut off and sent; the Emperor was angry at Yanchou and the others.
translations.idiomatic: 」They sent his head instead and Mingzong was angry with Yanchou and the others.

sentences.zh: 時議皆以為安重誨方弄國權，從榮諸王敬事不暇，獨忌從珂威名，每於帝前屢言其短，巧作窺圖，冀能傾陷。

translations.literal: At the time opinion held that An Chonghui was manipulating state power; Prince Congrong and the other princes could scarcely attend to courtesy, but he alone resented Congke's renown and repeatedly spoke of his faults before the Emperor, craftily plotting, hoping to bring him down.
translations.idiomatic: Opinion held that An Chonghui monopolized power while Congrong and other princes barely kept up courtesy; Chonghui alone envied Congke and repeatedly slandered him to Mingzong hoping to destroy him.

sentences.zh: 彥溫既誅，從珂歸清化裏第。

translations.literal: After Yanwen was executed, Congke returned to his residence on Qinghua Lane.
translations.idiomatic: After Yanwen's execution Congke returned to his Qinghua Lane residence.

sentences.zh: 重誨謂馮道等曰：「蒲帥失守，責帥之義，法當如何？

translations.literal: Chonghui said to Feng Dao and others: "The Pu commander lost his post—what is the law for punishing a commander?"
translations.idiomatic: Chonghui asked Feng Dao and others what penalty applied when a Hedong commander lost his command.

sentences.zh: 」翌日，道等奏：「合行朝典。

translations.literal: 」The next day Dao and others memorialized: "The court code should be applied.
translations.idiomatic: 」The next day they said the court code should apply.

sentences.zh: 」帝不悅，趙鳳堅奏：「故事有責帥之義，所以激勵藩守。

translations.literal: 」The Emperor was displeased; Zhao Feng firmly memorialized: "Precedent has the rule for punishing commanders to encourage frontier defenders.
translations.idiomatic: 」Mingzong was displeased, but Zhao Feng insisted precedent punished commanders to spur frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「皆非公等意也。

translations.literal: 」The Emperor said: "This is not your idea.
translations.idiomatic: 」Mingzong said that was not their own idea.

sentences.zh: 」後數日，帝於中興殿見宰臣，趙鳳承重誨意，又再論列，帝默然。

translations.literal: 」Several days later, when the Emperor received the chancellors at the Zhongxing Hall, Zhao Feng carried out Chonghui's intent and argued again; the Emperor was silent.
translations.idiomatic: 」Days later at the Zhongxing Hall Zhao Feng again pressed Chonghui's case and Mingzong stayed silent.

sentences.zh: 翌日，重誨復自論奏，帝極言以拒之，語在《末帝紀》中。

translations.literal: The next day Chonghui again argued his memorial himself; the Emperor strongly refused—the account is in the 《Annals of the Last Emperor》.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Chonghui argued again and Mingzong firmly refused, as told in the 《Annals of the Last Emperor》.

sentences.zh: 帝又曰：「卿欲如何製置？

translations.literal: The Emperor also said: "What disposition do you wish to make?"
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong also asked what disposition Chonghui wanted.

sentences.zh: 」重誨曰：「於陛下父子之間，臣不合言，一稟聖旨。

translations.literal: 」Chonghui said: "Between Your Majesty's father and son it is not fitting for me to speak—I leave it entirely to the sacred decree.
translations.idiomatic: 」Chonghui said father and son were not his to judge and he would follow the imperial decree.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「從佗私第閑坐，何煩奏也！

translations.literal: 」The Emperor said: "Let him sit idle in another's private residence—why trouble with memorials!"
translations.idiomatic: 」Mingzong said Congke could sit quietly elsewhere and need not be memorialized about.

sentences.zh: 」乃止。

translations.literal: 」And it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: 」And the matter ended.

sentences.zh: 以前邢州節度使、檢校司徒李從溫為左武衛上將軍。

translations.literal: Former Xing prefecture military commissioner and Inspector Master of Ceremonies Li Congwen was made Left Martial Guard senior general.
translations.idiomatic: Li Congwen, former Xing commissioner and inspector master of ceremonies, became left martial guard senior general.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以西京留守、檢校司徒索自通為河中節度使。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Western Capital regent and Inspector Master of Ceremonies Suo Zitong was made Hedong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Suo Zitong became Hedong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，雲州奏：掩襲契丹，獲頭口萬計。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Yun prefecture memorialized: raiding the Khitan, over ten thousand head and mouths were captured.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Yun reported a Khitan raid capturing over ten thousand head and people.

sentences.zh: 戊午，帝御文明殿受冊徽號，冊曰：「維長興元年，歲次庚寅，四月甲午朔，二十五日戊午，金紫光祿大夫、守尚書左僕射兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事、充太微宮使、宏文館大學士、上柱國、始平郡開國侯、食邑一千五百戶、食實封一百戶臣馮道，銀青光祿大夫、門下侍郎兼吏部尚書、同中書門下平章事、監修國史、判集賢院事、上柱國、天水郡開國伯、食邑七百戶臣趙鳳，及文武百官特進、太子少傅、上柱國、酒泉郡開國侯、食邑一千戶臣李琪等五千八百九十七人言：

translations.literal: On wuwu, the Emperor took the Civilized Illumination Hall to receive investiture of the honorific title; the document read: "In the first year of Changxing, cyclical year gengyin, fourth month jiawu new moon, twenty-fifth day wuwu, Jinzi Glory Grand Master, acting Left Vice Director of the Secretariat with concurrent Gate Department Vice Director, Grand Councillor, commissioner of the Supreme Palace of the Purple Subtlety, Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall, Supreme Pillar of State, Marquis of Shiping with a fief of one thousand five hundred households and a substantive enfeoffment of one hundred households, subject Feng Dao; Silver Glory Grand Master, Gate Department Vice Director with concurrent Minister of Personnel, Grand Councillor, supervisor of compilation of state history, director of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, Supreme Pillar of State, Earl of Tianshui with a fief of seven hundred households, subject Zhao Feng, and civil and military officials of special advancement, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, Supreme Pillar of State, Marquis of Jiuquan with a fief of one thousand households, subject Li Qi, and others—five thousand eight hundred ninety-seven persons—state:
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Mingzong at the Civilized Illumination Hall received the honorific investiture opening: "Changxing 1, year gengyin, fourth month jiawu new moon, day wuwu—Feng Dao, Zhao Feng, Li Qi, and five thousand eight hundred ninety-seven civil and military officials state:"

sentences.zh: 臣聞天不稱高而體尊，地不矜厚而形大，厚無不載，高無不覆。

translations.literal: We have heard that Heaven does not call itself high yet its body is honored, Earth does not boast of thickness yet its form is great—thick, nothing is not borne; high, nothing is not covered.
translations.idiomatic: They said Heaven need not call itself high to be honored and Earth need not boast thickness to be vast—nothing lies outside their cover.

sentences.zh: 四時行於內，萬物生其間，總神祗之靈，葉帝王之運。

translations.literal: The four seasons move within, the ten thousand things are born among them, gathering the spirits of gods, bearing the fortune of emperors.
translations.idiomatic: Seasons turn within, all things are born, spirits gather, and imperial fortune is borne.

sentences.zh: 日出而星辰自戢，龍飛而雷雨皆行，元氣和而天下和，庶事正而天下正。

translations.literal: When the sun comes out the stars withdraw of themselves; when the dragon flies thunder and rain all proceed; primal energy harmonizes and the realm harmonizes, every affair is corrected and the realm is corrected.
translations.idiomatic: As the sun rises stars withdraw, as the dragon flies rain follows, primal harmony brings worldly harmony and right rule steadies the realm.

sentences.zh: 伏惟皇帝陛下，天授一德，時曆多艱。

translations.literal: We respectfully consider that Your Majesty the Emperor, Heaven bestowed one virtue, the age traversed many hardships.
translations.idiomatic: They declared that His Majesty, Heaven-gifted in virtue, had passed through many hardships.

sentences.zh: 翊太祖以興邦，佐先皇而定難，拯嗣昭於潞困，救德威於燕危，遏思遠而全鄴都，誅彥章而下梁苑。

translations.literal: You aided the Founding Ancestor to raise the state, assisted the former emperor to settle calamity, rescued Sizhao at Lu's distress, saved Dewei at Yan's peril, checked Siyuan and preserved Ye capital, executed Yanzhang and took down Liang's park.
translations.idiomatic: He had aided the founding ancestor, settled Zhuangzong's crises, rescued Sizhao at Lu, saved Dewei at Yan, checked Siyuan, preserved Ye, executed Yanzhang, and took Liang's capital.

sentences.zh: 成再造之業，由四征之功。

translations.literal: You completed the work of second restoration through the merit of four campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: Second restoration came through four campaigns' merit.

sentences.zh: 洎纂鴻圖，每敷皇化。

translations.literal: When you succeeded to the great design, you ever spread imperial transformation.
translations.idiomatic: Since taking the throne he had ever spread imperial rule.

sentences.zh: 去內庫而省庖膳，出宮人而減伶官，輕寶玉之珍，卻鷹鸇之貢。

translations.literal: You removed the inner treasury and reduced palace kitchens, released palace women and cut entertainers, made light of jade treasures, and refused hawk and falcon tribute.
translations.idiomatic: He emptied inner treasuries, cut kitchens and entertainers, released palace women, spurned gems, and refused hunting birds.

sentences.zh: 淳風既洽，嘉瑞自臻。

translations.literal: Pure wind having permeated, auspicious omens came of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: As pure customs spread, auspicious omens appeared.

sentences.zh: 故登極之前，人皆不足；

translations.literal: Therefore before ascending the throne, the people all fell short;
translations.idiomatic: Before his accession the people had scarcely prospered;

sentences.zh: 改元之後，時便有年。

translations.literal: after changing the era name, the age at once had years of plenty.
translations.idiomatic: after the era change the age soon knew abundance.

sentences.zh: 遐荒旋斃於戎王，重譯徑來於蠻子，東巡而守殷殪，北討而王都殲，破契丹而燕、趙無虞，控靈武而瓜、沙並復。

translations.literal: Distant wilds soon destroyed their war-lords; heavy interpreters came straight from barbarian sons; eastern tour and Yin was overthrown; northern campaign and the royal capital was taken; the Khitan were broken and Yan and Zhao were without worry; Lingwu was controlled and Gua and Sha were both recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier lords fell, tribute envoys came, eastern and northern campaigns succeeded, the Khitan were broken, Yan and Zhao were secure, and Lingwu brought Gua and Sha back.

sentences.zh: 近以饗上元而薦太廟，就吉土而配昊天，輅已降而雨沾，事欲行而月見。

translations.literal: Recently, feasting at the first yuan and offering at the Grand Shrine, taking the auspicious earth and matching the Supreme Lord of Heaven, the carriage had descended and rain moistened, the affair was about to proceed and the moon appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Recently at the Yuan offering and Grand Shrine rites, rain fell as the carriage descended and the moon shone as the rite was to begin.

sentences.zh: 燔柴禮畢，作解恩覃，帝命鹹均，人情普悅。

translations.literal: When the firewood offering was finished, amnesty was proclaimed; the imperial command was all equal, human feeling universally pleased.
translations.idiomatic: After the firewood offering amnesty spread and command and people alike rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 非陛下有道有德，至聖至明，動不疑人，靜惟恭己，常敦孝禮，每納忠言，則何以臨御五年，澄清四海！

translations.literal: Unless Your Majesty possessed the Way and virtue, utmost sagacity and utmost illumination, moving without doubting people, resting in reverent self-restraint, ever urging filial rites, and every time receiving loyal words—how could you have ruled five years and clarified the four seas!
translations.idiomatic: Only a ruler of utmost sagacity, self-restraint, filial rites, and loyal counsel could rule five years and clarify the four seas.

sentences.zh: 時久纏於災害，民驟見於和平。

translations.literal: For long years disaster had entangled the realm; suddenly the people saw peace.
translations.idiomatic: Long years of disaster had bound the realm; suddenly the people saw peace.

sentences.zh: 休征備載於簡編，徽號過持於謙讓。

translations.literal: Auspicious signs fully fill the annals, yet the honorific title you held back through modest refusal.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious omens fill the records, yet you held back the honorific style through modest refusal.

sentences.zh: 三年不允，眾誌皆堅。

translations.literal: Three years you did not assent; everyone's resolve was firm.
translations.idiomatic: Three years you refused; every will was firm.

sentences.zh: 天不以上帝自崇，日不以大明自貴，於烝民有惠，於元後同符，列聖皆然，舊章斯在。

translations.literal: Heaven does not exalt itself as Supreme Lord, the sun does not prize itself as Great Brightness—when the masses are benefited and the primal sovereign's tally matches, so have all sage emperors; the old statutes stand.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven does not exalt itself as supreme lord nor the sun as great brightness; when the people are benefited and the primal sovereign's mandate aligns, so have all sage rulers—the old rule stands.

sentences.zh: 今以明庭百辟，列土諸侯，中外同辭，再三瀝懇。

translations.literal: Now the hundred ministers of the bright court, feudal lords of the circuits, inner and outer offices with one voice, repeatedly pour out earnest pleas.
translations.idiomatic: Now the hundred ministers of the bright court, circuit lords, and inner and outer offices speak as one, pleading again and again.

sentences.zh: 臣等不勝大願，謹奉玉寶玉冊，上號曰聖明神武文德恭孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Your subjects cannot bear this great wish; we respectfully present the jade seal and jade book, setting the style as Sagely, Bright, Divinely Martial, Culturally Virtuous, Reverent, and Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: We cannot contain this great wish; we respectfully present the jade seal and book and set your style as Sagely, Bright, Divinely Martial, Culturally Virtuous, Reverent, and Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 伏惟皇帝陛下，體堯、舜之至道，法日月於太虛，威於夷狄，恩及蟲魚。

translations.literal: We bow before Your Majesty, embodying Yao and Shun's utmost Way, taking sun and moon as models in the Great Void—awe to barbarians, grace reaching insects and fish.
translations.idiomatic: We bow before Your Majesty, embodying Yao and Shun's utmost Way and taking sun and moon as models in the void—awe to barbarians, grace to insects and fish.

sentences.zh: 奉國者繼加榮寵，違天者鹹就誅鋤。

translations.literal: Those who served the state received successive honors; those who defied Heaven were all cut down.
translations.idiomatic: Those who served the state won successive honors; those who defied Heaven were all destroyed.

sentences.zh: 典禮當告成之後，夙夜思即位之初，千秋萬歲，永混車書。

translations.literal: Rites were completed and announced; day and night you recall assuming the throne—may you reign ten thousand ages, forever uniting carriage and script.
translations.idiomatic: Rites were done and announced; day and night you recall your accession—may you reign ten thousand years and forever unite the realm.

sentences.zh: 宰臣馮道之辭也。

translations.literal: This was Chancellor Feng Dao's wording.
translations.idiomatic: This was Chancellor Feng Dao's wording.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以左多吾上將軍史敬熔為鄧州節度使，以右金吾上將軍符彥超為兗州節度使，以驍衛上將軍張敬詢為滑州節度使，以閬州防禦使孫嶽為鳳州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Left Majestic Dragon senior general Shi Jingrong was made Dengzhou military commissioner; Right Gold Spears senior general Fu Yanchao was made Yanzhou military commissioner; Bold Guard senior general Zhang Jingxun was made Huazhou military commissioner; Langzhou defense commissioner Sun Yue was made Fengzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Shi Jingrong became Deng commissioner; Fu Yanchao of right Gold Spears became Yan commissioner; Zhang Jingxun of bold guard became Hua commissioner; Sun Yue of Lang became Feng commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔改鳳翔管內應州為匡州，信州為晏州，改新州管內武州為毅州。

translations.literal: An edict changed Ying prefecture within Fengxiang circuit to Kuang prefecture, Xin prefecture to Yan prefecture, and Wu prefecture within Xin prefecture to Yi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong renamed Ying to Kuang and Xin to Yan in Fengxiang, and Wu to Yi in Xin circuit.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，鄭州防禦使張進、副使鹹繼威並停任，以盜掠城中居人故也。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yichou: Zhengzhou defense commissioner Zhang Jin and vice commissioner Xian Jiwei were both removed from office for plundering city residents.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the fifth month Zhang Jin of Zheng and vice commissioner Xian Jiwei were dismissed for robbing townspeople.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以少府監韋肅為洺州刺史，以潞州節度使王建立為太傅致仕。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Palace Workshops director Wei Su was made Luozhou prefect; Luzhou military commissioner Wang Jianli was made Grand Preceptor retired.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Wei Su became Luo prefect and Wang Jianli of Lu retired as grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 建立素與安重誨不協，因其入朝，乃言建立自鎮歸朝過鄴都，日有扇搖之言，以是罪之，故令致仕。

translations.literal: Jianli had long been at odds with An Chonghui; when he came to court Chonghui said that on returning from his command and passing through Yedu he daily spread agitating words—hence the charge and order to retire.
translations.idiomatic: Jianli had long clashed with Chonghui; when he came to court Chonghui said he had spread sedition passing through Yedu on his return—hence forced retirement.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以前興元節度使劉仲殷權知潞州軍州事。

translations.literal: On dingmao, former Xingyuan military commissioner Liu Zhongyin was made acting regent of Luzhou headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Liu Zhongyin, former Xingyuan commissioner, became acting Luz regent.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以安州節度使高行珪卒輟朝。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Anzhou military commissioner Gao Xinggui died; court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Gao Xinggui of An died; court mourned.

sentences.zh: 有司上言：「皇后受冊，內外命婦並合奉賀。

translations.literal: The relevant offices memorialized: "When the empress receives investiture, inner and outer titled ladies should all offer congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: The offices said: "When the empress is invested, titled ladies inside and out should all congratulate.

sentences.zh: 今未有命婦準例上表稱賀。

translations.literal: At present there is no precedent for titled ladies to submit congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: There is no precedent for titled ladies' congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 中書門下奏：諸道節度使但進表上言皇帝，外命婦上皇后賀箋表，進呈訖，無報。

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: circuit military commissioners should submit memorials only to the emperor; outer titled ladies should submit congratulatory letters to the empress; once presented, no reply.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat said: commissioners should memorialize only the emperor; outer ladies should send congratulatory letters to the empress with no reply.

sentences.zh: 應皇親或有慶賀及起居章表，內中進呈後，隻宣示來使，並不合答復。

translations.literal: For imperial kin with congratulations or routine memorials, after presentation within the palace only the envoy should be informed—no written reply.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial kin's congratulations or routine memorials, once presented within, should only be told to the envoy—no written reply.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以權知昭義軍軍州事劉仲殷為潞州節度使、檢校太傅。

translations.literal: On renshen, acting regent of Zhaoyi Army Liu Zhongyin was made Luzhou military commissioner and honorary Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Liu Zhongyin became Lu commissioner and honorary grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，帝臨軒，命使冊淑妃曹氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On dingchou the Emperor faced the throne hall and ordered envoys to invest Worthy Consort Cao as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Mingzong faced the throne hall and sent envoys to invest Consort Cao as empress.

sentences.zh: 禮院上言，百官上疏於皇后曰「皇后殿下」，及六宮及率土婦人慶賀隻呼「殿下」，不言「皇后」。

translations.literal: The Ritual Office memorialized that officials' memorials to the empress should read "Her Majesty the Empress," and for the six palaces and all women congratulating they should call only "Her Majesty," not "Empress."
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Office said officials should address the empress as "Her Majesty the Empress" in memorials, while the six palaces and all women should say only "Her Majesty" in congratulations.

sentences.zh: 中書覆奏，若隻呼「殿下」，恐與皇太子無所分別，凡上中宮表章呼「皇后殿下」，若不形文字，尋常隻呼「皇后」。

translations.literal: The Secretariat replied: if only "Her Majesty" were used, it might not be distinguished from the crown prince; all memorials to the inner palace should read "Her Majesty the Empress," and in speech without written form ordinarily "Empress."
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat replied that "Her Majesty" alone might confuse the crown prince; written memorials should say "Her Majesty the Empress," while speech should say "Empress."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 癸未，太子少傅蕭頃卒，廢朝。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Crown Prince Junior Tutor Xiao Xiang died; court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Xiao Xiang died; court mourned.

sentences.zh: 甲申，回鶻可汗仁裕遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Uighur qaghan Renyu sent envoys with tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Uighur qaghan Renyu sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以翰林承旨、兵部侍郎李愚為太常卿。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Hanlin exequatur and Vice Minister of Rites Li Yu was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Yu—Hanlin exequatur and vice rites minister—became rites minister.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以前滑州節度使李從璋為左驍衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On renchen, former Huazhou military commissioner Li Congzhang was made Left Bold Cavalry senior general.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Li Congzhang became left bold cavalry senior general.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，以護駕馬軍都指揮使、貴州刺史安從進為宣州節度使，充護駕馬軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: Sixth month, dingyou: Imperial Escort Horse Army commander-in-chief and Guizhou prefect An Congjin was made Xuanzhou military commissioner, continuing as Imperial Escort Horse Army commander-in-chief;
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the sixth month An Congjin—escort horse commander and Gui prefect—became Xuan commissioner, keeping horse command;

sentences.zh: 以護駕步軍都指揮使、澄州刺史藥彥稠為壽州節度使兼護駕步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Imperial Escort Foot Army commander-in-chief and Chenzhou prefect Yao Yanchou was made Shouzhou military commissioner and concurrent Imperial Escort Foot Army commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yanchou—escort foot commander and Chen prefect—became Shou commissioner and foot commander.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以皇城使安崇緒為河陽留後，重誨子也。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Imperial City commissioner An Chongxu was made Heyang regent—Chonghui's son.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen An Chongxu became Heyang regent—Chonghui's son.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔奏：「所管良、晏、匡三州並無屬縣，請卻改為縣。

translations.literal: Fengxiang memorialized: "The three prefectures Liang, Yan, and Kuang under our jurisdiction have no subordinate counties; we ask that they be changed back to counties.
translations.idiomatic: Fengxiang said: "Liang, Yan, and Kuang have no counties; we ask to revert them to counties.

sentences.zh: 」從之，仍舊為軍鎮。

translations.literal: " It was approved; they remained army commands as before.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved; they stayed army commands as before.

sentences.zh: 前振武節度使安金全卒。

translations.literal: Former Zhenwu military commissioner An Jinquan died.
translations.idiomatic: Former Zhenwu commissioner An Jinquan died.

sentences.zh: 壬子，中書門下奏：「詳覆到禮部院今年及第進士李飛、樊吉、夏侯珙、吳沺、王德柔、李穀等六人，望放及第。

translations.literal: On renzi the Secretariat memorialized: "Upon review at the Ministry of Rites this year's passed jinshi Li Fei, Fan Ji, Xiahou Gong, Wu Dian, Wang Derou, and Li Gu—six men—are wished to be released as passed.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the Secretariat said: "After review, this year's six passed candidates Li Fei, Fan Ji, Xiahou Gong, Wu Dian, Wang Derou, and Li Gu should be graduated.

sentences.zh: 其盧價等七人及賓貢鄭樸，望許令將來就試。

translations.literal: The seven including Lu Jia and guest-examinee Zheng Pu are wished to be allowed to take the examination in the future.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jia's seven and guest examinee Zheng Pu should be allowed to test later.

sentences.zh: 知貢舉張文寶試士不得精當，望罰一季俸。

translations.literal: Examination director Zhang Wenbao did not test scholars with proper care; we wish one season's salary fined.
translations.idiomatic: Director Zhang Wenbao tested poorly; we ask one season's salary be fined.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，皇子北京留守、河東節度使從厚移領鎮州，以左武衛上將軍李從溫為許州節度使。

translations.literal: On dingsi, imperial son Beijing regent and Hedong military commissioner Conghou was transferred to command Zhenzhou; Left Martial Guard senior general Li Congwen was made Xuzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Conghou moved from Beijing and Hedong to Zhen; Li Congwen became Xu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，以宣徽南院使、行右衛上將軍、判三司馮贇為北京留守、太原尹。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiazi: Palace Secretariat southern commissioner, acting Right Guard senior general, and Director of the Three Bureaus Feng Yun was made Beijing regent and Taiyuan prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the seventh month Feng Yun—southern secretariat commissioner, acting right guard general, and three bureaus director—became Beijing regent and Taiyuan prefect.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以鄧州節度使史敬鎔卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On jisi, Dengzhou military commissioner Shi Jingrong died; court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Shi Jingrong of Deng died; court mourned.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以左威衛上將軍梁漢顒為鄧州節度使，前兗州節度使趙在禮為左驍衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Left Majestic Might senior general Liang Hanyong was made Dengzhou military commissioner; former Yanzhou military commissioner Zhao Zaili was made Left Bold Cavalry senior general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Liang Hanyong became Deng commissioner and Zhao Zaili became left bold cavalry senior general.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，奉國軍節度使兼威武軍節度副使、檢校太尉、兼侍中王延稟加兼中書令。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Fengguo Army military commissioner and concurrent Weiwu Army deputy military commissioner, honorary Grand Preceptor, and Palace Attendant Wang Yanbin gained concurrent Secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Wang Yanbin of Fengguo and Weiwu gained concurrent Secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 詔：「諸州得替防禦、團練使、刺史並宜於班行比擬，如未有員闕，可隨常參官逐日立班。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Defense, training, and prefectural commissioners who have left office should be ranked in court procession; if no vacancy exists, they may stand in daily court with regular attendees.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong ordered that outgoing defense, training, and prefectural commissioners join court ranks, or stand with regular attendees if no vacancy.

sentences.zh: 」新例也。

translations.literal: " A new precedent.
translations.idiomatic: " A new rule.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔揀年少宮人及西川宮人並還其家，無家可歸者，任從所適。

translations.literal: On xinsi an edict selected young palace women and Sichuan palace women and returned them to their families; those with no home might go where they wished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Mingzong released young palace women and Sichuan palace women to their families, or let the homeless go as they wished.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以前齊州防禦使孫璋為鄜州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiashen, former Qizhou defense commissioner Sun Zhang was made Yanzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Sun Zhang became Yan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以右散騎常侍陸崇卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Right Regular Cavalier Lu Chong died; court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Lu Chong died; court mourned.

sentences.zh: 崇為福建冊使，卒於明州，贈兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Chong had been Fujian investiture envoy; he died at Mingzhou and was posthumously made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Chong, Fujian investiture envoy, died at Ming and was posthumously made war minister.

sentences.zh: 宿州進白兔，安重誨謂其使曰：「豐年為上瑞，兔懷狡性，雖白何為！

translations.literal: Suzhou presented a white hare; An Chonghui told its envoy: "A bountiful year is the supreme auspice—what use is a hare's crafty nature, though white!
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou presented a white hare; Chonghui told the envoy: "A full harvest is the supreme omen—what good is a crafty hare, though white!

sentences.zh: 」命退歸。

translations.literal: " He ordered them to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: " He sent them back.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，以前鄧州節度使盧文進為左衛上將軍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiawu: former Dengzhou military commissioner Lu Wenjin was made Left Guard senior general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the eighth month Lu Wenjin became left guard senior general.

sentences.zh: 北京奏，吐渾千餘帳內附，於天池川安置。

translations.literal: Beijing reported that more than a thousand Tuyuhun households submitted and were settled at Tianchi River.
translations.idiomatic: Beijing reported over a thousand Tuyuhun households submitted and were settled at Tianchi River.

sentences.zh: 禁在京百司影射州縣稅戶。

translations.literal: It was forbidden for capital offices to divert prefectural tax households.
translations.idiomatic: Capital offices were forbidden to divert prefectural taxpayers.

sentences.zh: 乙未，捧聖軍使李行德、十將張儉、告密人邊彥溫並族誅，以其誣告安重誨私市兵仗故也。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Pingsheng Army commissioner Li Xingde, company officer Zhang Jian, and informer Bian Yanwen were all executed by clan extermination for falsely accusing An Chonghui of privately trading weapons.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Li Xingde, Zhang Jian, and Bian Yanwen were clan-executed for falsely accusing Chonghui of private arms trade.

sentences.zh: 以前許州節度使張延朗為檢校太傅、行兵部尚書，充三司使。

translations.literal: Former Xuzhou military commissioner Zhang Yanlang was made honorary Grand Preceptor, acting Minister of War, and Three Bureaus commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanlang, former Xu commissioner, became honorary grand preceptor, acting war minister, and three bureaus commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三司之有使額，自延朗始也。

translations.literal: The Three Bureaus commissioner title began with Yanlang.
translations.idiomatic: The three bureaus commissioner title began with Yanlang.

sentences.zh: 初，中書覆奏，授延朗諸道鹽鐵轉運等使，兼判戶部度支事。

translations.literal: Initially the Secretariat replied and appointed Yanlang Commissioner of Salt and Iron Transport for all circuits, concurrently judging Ministry of Revenue fiscal affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the Secretariat appointed Yanlang salt-and-iron transport commissioner for all circuits and fiscal judge of revenue.

sentences.zh: 奏入，宣旨曰：「會計之司，國朝重事，將總成其事額，俾專委於近臣，貴便一時，何循往例，兼移內職，可示新規。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, an edict said: "The accounting office is a dynastic weight; we shall consolidate its duties and entrust them to a close minister for present convenience—why follow old precedent? Transferring an inner-office post shows a new rule.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial entered and Mingzong said: "Accounting is a dynastic weight; we consolidate it under a close minister for convenience—not old precedent. An inner transfer shows a new rule.

sentences.zh: 張延朗可充三司使，班在宣徽使下。

translations.literal: Zhang Yanlang may serve as Three Bureaus commissioner, ranked below the Palace Secretariat commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanlang may be three bureaus commissioner, ranked below palace secretariat commissioners.

sentences.zh: 」癸卯，北京奏，生吐渾內附，欲於嵐州安族帳。

translations.literal: " On guimao, Beijing reported native Tuyuhun submitting and wishing to settle clan tents at Lan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: " On guimao Beijing reported native Tuyuhun wishing to settle at Lan.

sentences.zh: 都官員外郎、知制誥張昭遠奏：「請依國朝舊以例，選郎官、御史分行天下，宣問風俗，興利除害。

translations.literal: Director of Justice aide and edict drafter Zhang Zhaoyuan memorialized: "We ask to follow the dynasty's old precedent of selecting palace and censorate officials to tour the realm, inquire into customs, and promote benefit and remove harm.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhaoyuan, justice aide and edict drafter, asked to revive the old practice of sending palace and censorate officials to tour the realm, inquire into customs, and promote benefit and remove harm.

sentences.zh: 」不報。

translations.literal: " No reply.
translations.idiomatic: " No reply.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，皇子河南尹、判六軍諸衛事從榮封秦王，仍令所司擇日冊命。

translations.literal: On renyin, imperial son Henan prefect, judge of the Six Armies and guards Congrong was enfeoffed Prince of Qin, with the relevant offices ordered to choose a day for investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Congrong—Henan prefect and judge of the Six Armies—was enfeoffed Prince of Qin, with investiture day to be chosen.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：長興元年九月，太常禮院奏，草定冊秦王儀注。

translations.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: ninth month, first year of Changxing, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ritual Office memorialized, drafting investiture rites for the Prince of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 says in the ninth month of Changxing 1 the ritual office drafted Prince of Qin investiture rites.

sentences.zh: 博士段顒議曰：據《開元禮》，臨軒冊命諸王大臣，其日受冊者，朝服從第鹵簿，與百官俱集朝堂，就次受冊訖，通事舍人引，不載謁朝還第之儀。

translations.literal: Doctor Duan Yan argued: according to the 《Kaiyuan Rites》, when investing kings and great ministers at the throne hall, on that day the investee in court dress with estate guard of honor and all officials gathers at the court hall, receives investiture at his place, and the protocol officer leads him off—the rites do not record returning to court or estate.
translations.idiomatic: Doctor Duan Yan cited the 《Kaiyuan Rites》: at throne-hall investiture the prince in court dress with estate escort and officials gathered at court, received the book, and was led off—with no rite of returning to court or home.

sentences.zh: 自開元以後，冊拜諸王皆正衙命使，詣延英進冊，皇帝御內殿，高品引王入立於位，高品宣製讀冊，王受冊訖，歸院，亦無乘輅謁朝之禮。

translations.literal: Since Kaiyuan, investing princes has all been by envoys at the main court proceeding to Yanying to present the book; the emperor presided in the inner hall, a senior officer led the prince to his place, a senior officer proclaimed the edict and read the book, and after receiving investiture the prince returned to his residence—again without the rite of riding the carriage to court.
translations.idiomatic: Since Kaiyuan, princes were invested by main-court envoys at Yanying; the emperor sat in the inner hall, a senior officer led the prince in, read the edict and book, and the prince returned home—again without riding to court.

sentences.zh: 臣按《五禮精義》云：「古者皆因禘嘗而頒爵祿，所以示無自專，稟之於祖宗也。

translations.literal: I find in the 《Essentials of the Five Rites》: "In antiquity rank and fief were always bestowed at the autumnal and spring ancestral rites, to show one did not act on one's own but received from the ancestors."
translations.idiomatic: He cited the 《Essentials of the Five Rites》: "Anciently rank and fief were bestowed at ancestral rites, showing one did not act alone but received from ancestors."

sentences.zh: 」今雖冊命，不在烝嘗，然拜大官、封大邑，必至殿廷，敬慎之道也。

translations.literal: " Though investiture is not at the seasonal rites, receiving great office and great fief must reach the hall—this is the way of reverent care.
translations.idiomatic: " Though not at seasonal rites, great office and great fief must reach the hall—that is reverent care.

sentences.zh: 今當司欲準《開元禮》，其日秦王服朝服，自理所乘輅車、備鹵簿，與群臣俱集朝堂，就次受冊訖，至應天門外，奉冊置於載冊之車，秦王升輅，出謁太廟訖，歸理所，儀仗鹵簿如來時之儀。

translations.literal: The present office wishes to follow the 《Kaiyuan Rites》: on that day the Prince of Qin in court dress, from his residence mounting his carriage with guard of honor, with all ministers gathering at court and receiving investiture at his place; then outside Xuande Gate placing the book on the book carriage, the prince mounting his carriage, going to pay court at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, then returning to his residence—the guard of honor as on arrival.
translations.idiomatic: The office wished to follow the 《Kaiyuan Rites》: the prince in court dress would ride from his residence with escort, gather at court, receive investiture, place the book on the carriage outside Xuande Gate, ride to the ancestral temple, then return home with the same escort.

sentences.zh: 從之。）〉

translations.literal: It was approved.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Approved.)〉

sentences.zh: 戊申，兗州奏：「淮南海州都指揮使王傳拯殺本州刺史陳宣，焚燒州城，以所部兵士及家口五千人歸國，至沂州。

translations.literal: On wushen, Yanzhou memorialized: "Huainan Haizhou commander-in-chief Wang Chuanzheng killed the prefect Chen Xuan, burned the prefectural city, and with his troops and households—five thousand—submitted to the state, reaching Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Yan reported Haizhou commander Wang Chuanzheng had killed prefect Chen Xuan, burned the city, and brought five thousand troops and families to submit at Yi.

sentences.zh: 」帝遣使慰納之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor sent envoys to comfort and accept them.
translations.idiomatic: " Mingzong sent envoys to comfort and accept them.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，正衙命使冊福慶長公主孟氏。

translations.literal: On gengxu, envoys at the main court were ordered to invest Princess Fuqing, surname Meng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu main-court envoys invested Princess Fuqing Meng.

sentences.zh: 以前雄武軍節度使王思同為左武衛上將軍，以前鳳州節度使陳皋為右威衛上將軍。

translations.literal: Former Xiongwu Army military commissioner Wang Sitong was made Left Martial Guard senior general; former Fengzhou military commissioner Chen Gao was made Right Majestic Might senior general.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sitong became left martial guard senior general; Chen Gao of Feng became right majestic might senior general.

sentences.zh: 壬子，正衙命使赴太原，冊永寧公主石氏。

translations.literal: On renzi, envoys at the main court were sent to Taiyuan to invest Princess Yongning, surname Shi.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi main-court envoys went to Taiyuan to invest Princess Yongning Shi.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以左監門衛上將軍陳延福卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On yimao, Left Gate Guard senior general Chen Yanfu died; court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Chen Yanfu died; court mourned.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，皇子鎮州節度使從厚封宋王，仍令擇日冊命。

translations.literal: On bingchen, imperial son Zhenzhou military commissioner Conghou was enfeoffed Prince of Song, with a day for investiture still to be chosen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Conghou of Zhen was enfeoffed Prince of Song, with investiture day to be chosen.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，階州刺史王宏贄上言：「一州主客戶才及千戶，並無縣局，臣今檢括得新舊主客已及三千二百，欲依舊額立將利、福津二縣，請置令佐。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yichou: Jie prefecture prefect Wang Hongzan memorialized: "This prefecture has barely a thousand main and guest households and no county offices; I have now tallied old and new main and guest households at three thousand two hundred and wish to establish the two counties Jiangli and Fujin by the old quota and request magistrates and aides.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the ninth month Wang Hongzan of Jie said the prefecture had barely a thousand households and no counties; he tallied three thousand two hundred and asked to restore Jiangli and Fujin counties with magistrates.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔天下諸州府，不得奏薦著紫衣官員為州縣官。

translations.literal: On dingchou an edict said that throughout the realm prefectures and circuits might not recommend officials wearing purple for prefectural and county posts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Mingzong forbade recommending purple-robed officials for prefectural and county posts.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，升尚書右丞為正四品。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Right Secretariat director was raised to regular fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the right secretariat director was raised to regular fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 癸未，利、閬、遂三州奏，東川節度使董璋謀叛，結連西川孟知祥。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Li, Lang, and Su prefectures memorialized that Dongchuan military commissioner Dong Zhang plotted rebellion and allied with Xichuan Meng Zhixiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Li, Lang, and Su reported Dongchuan commissioner Dong Zhang plotting rebellion with Xichuan Meng Zhixiang.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以鎮州節度使範延光為檢校太傅、守刑部尚書，充樞密使。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Zhenzhou military commissioner Fan Yanguang was made honorary Grand Preceptor, Minister of Punishments, and Privy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Fan Yanguang of Zhen became honorary grand preceptor, punishments minister, and privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 利州、閬州進納東川檄書，言將兵擊利、閬，責以間諜朝廷為名。

translations.literal: Li and Lang prefectures forwarded Dongchuan proclamations saying they would attack Li and Lang, charging espionage against the court.
translations.idiomatic: Li and Lang forwarded Dongchuan proclamations threatening attack and charging court espionage.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以左驍衛上將軍趙在禮為同州節度使兼四面行營馬步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Left Bold Cavalry senior general Zhao Zaili was made Tongzhou military commissioner and concurrent commander-in-chief of the Four Fronts field army horse and foot.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Zhao Zaili became Tong commissioner and four-fronts field army commander.

sentences.zh: 樞密院直學士、守工部侍郎閻至，樞密院直學士、守尚書右丞史圭，並轉戶部侍郎，依前充職。

translations.literal: Privy Council regular academician and acting Vice Minister of Works Yan Zhi, and Privy Council regular academician and acting Right Secretariat director Shi Gui, were both transferred to Vice Minister of Revenue, continuing at their posts.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zhi and Shi Gui—privy regular academics—became vice revenue ministers at rank.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、守戶部侍郎李懌為尚書右丞；

translations.literal: Hanlin academician and acting Vice Minister of Revenue Li Yun was made Right Secretariat director;
translations.idiomatic: Li Yun became right secretariat director;

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、戶部侍郎劉煦為兵部侍郎；

translations.literal: Hanlin academician and Vice Minister of Revenue Liu Xu was made Vice Minister of War;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xu became vice war minister;

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、中書舍人竇夢征為工部侍郎，依前充職。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician and Secretariat aide Dou Mengzheng was made Vice Minister of Works, continuing at his post.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Mengzheng became vice works minister at rank.

sentences.zh: 以中書舍人劉讚為御史中丞，以御史中丞許光義為兵部侍即，以兵部侍郎姚顗為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: Secretariat aide Liu Zan was made Censor-in-chief; Censor-in-chief Xu Guangyi was made Vice Minister of War; Vice Minister of War Yao Yan was made Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zan became censor-in-chief; Xu Guangyi became vice war minister; Yao Yan became vice personnel minister.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔東川節度使董璋可削奪在身官爵，仍征兵進討。

translations.literal: On bingxu an edict said Dongchuan military commissioner Dong Zhang's current ranks and titles might be stripped and troops raised to attack.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Mingzong stripped Dong Zhang's ranks and ordered troops to attack.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以西川節度使孟知祥兼西南面供饋使，天雄軍節度使石敬瑭兼東川行營都招討使，以遂州節度使夏魯奇兼東川行營招討副使。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Xichuan military commissioner Meng Zhixiang was made concurrent southwest supply commissioner; Tianxiong military commissioner Shi Jingtang was made concurrent Dongchuan campaign commander-in-chief; Suizhou military commissioner Xia Luqi was made concurrent Dongchuan campaign deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Meng Zhixiang became southwest supply commissioner; Shi Jingtang became Dongchuan campaign commander; Xia Luqi became deputy.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以右衛上將軍王思同為京兆尹，充西京留守兼西南行營馬步都虞候。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Right Guard senior general Wang Sitong was made Jingzhao prefect, Western Capital regent, and southwest campaign horse-and-foot deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Wang Sitong became Jingzhao prefect, Luoyang regent, and southwest campaign deputy.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬辰，以太子少傅李琪卒廢朝。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, renchen: Crown Prince Junior Tutor Li Qi died; court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the tenth month Li Qi died; court mourned.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以鄜州節度使米君立卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On guisi, Yanzhou military commissioner Mi Junli died; court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Mi Junli of Yan died; court mourned.

sentences.zh: 詔：「凡賻贈布帛，言段不言端匹，段者二丈也，宜令三司依此給付。

translations.literal: An edict said: "For all funeral gifts of cloth and silk, speak in sections (duan) and not in full bolts; a section is two zhang; the Three Bureaus should disburse accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Funeral gifts of cloth and silk should be counted in sections, not full bolts—a section is two zhang—and the Three Bureaus should pay out accordingly.

sentences.zh: 」甲午，正衙命使冊興平公主於宋州節度使、駙馬都尉趙延壽之私第。

translations.literal: " On jiawu envoys appointed at the main court invested Princess Xingping at the private residence of Song military commissioner and Commandant of Escort Cavalry Zhao Yanshou.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiawu envoys at the main court invested Princess Xingping at the home of Song commissioner and Commandant of Escort Cavalry Zhao Yanshou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以左驍衛上將軍李從璋為陝州節度使，陝州節度使劉彥琮移鎮邠州。

translations.literal: On jihai Left Pillar of Majestic Valor general Li Congzhang was made Shan military commissioner; Shan military commissioner Liu Yancong was transferred to Bin.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Li Congzhang of Left Pillar of Majestic Valor became Shan commissioner; Liu Yancong of Shan moved to Bin.

sentences.zh: 尚書博士田敏請依舊典藏冰、頒冰，以銷陰陽愆伏之沴，詔從之。

translations.literal: Court scholar Tian Min of the Ministry of Personnel asked to restore by old rule storing ice and distributing ice to dispel yin-yang excess and hidden plague; an edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: Personnel court scholar Tian Min asked to restore storing and distributing ice by old rule to dispel yin-yang excess and hidden plague; an edict approved.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》載原敕云：「藏冰之制，載在前經，獻廟之儀，廢於近代，既朝臣之特舉，案典禮以宜行。

translations.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 records the original edict: "The institution of storing ice is set out in earlier classics; the rite of presenting at the temple was abandoned in recent times; since the court officials specially proposed it, ritual precedent shows it should be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 records the original edict: "Storing ice is set out in earlier classics; presenting at the temple was abandoned in recent times; since officials specially proposed it, ritual precedent shows it should proceed.

sentences.zh: 田敏所奏祭司寒獻羔事宜依。

translations.literal: Tian Min's memorial on sacrificing to the Cold Lord and presenting a lamb is approved as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Min's memorial on sacrificing to the Cold Lord and presenting a lamb is approved as proposed.

sentences.zh: 其桃弧棘矢，事久不行，理難備創。

translations.literal: As for peach-wood bows and jujube arrows, the practice has long lapsed and cannot reasonably be newly instituted.
translations.idiomatic: Peach-wood bows and jujube arrows have long lapsed and cannot reasonably be newly instituted.

sentences.zh: 其諸侯亦宜準往製藏冰。」）〉

translations.literal: Princes should also store ice according to the former regulation.")〉
translations.idiomatic: Princes should also store ice by the former regulation.")〉

sentences.zh: 乙巳，供奉官張仁暉自利州回，奏董璋攻陷閬州，節度使李仁矩舉家遇害。

translations.literal: On yisi attendant Zhang Renhui returned from Li and reported that Dong Zhang had taken Lang; military commissioner Li Renju and his whole household were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi attendant Zhang Renhui returned from Li and reported Dong Zhang had taken Lang; commissioner Li Renju and his whole household were killed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，宮苑使董光業並妻子並斬於都市，璋之子也。

translations.literal: On dingwei palace park commissioner Dong Guangye, his wife, and children were all beheaded in the market—Zhang's son.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei palace park commissioner Dong Guangye, wife, and children were beheaded in the market—Zhang's son.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以武安軍節度副使、洪鄂道行營副都統、檢校太尉馬希聲為武安軍節度使，加兼侍中。

translations.literal: On xinhai Wuan deputy military commissioner, Hong-E route deputy campaign commander-in-chief, and honorary grand preceptor Ma Xisheng was made Wuan military commissioner, additionally palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Ma Xisheng—Wuan deputy commissioner, Hong-E route deputy commander, honorary grand preceptor—became Wuan commissioner, additionally palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 時湖南馬殷奏，久病不任軍政，乞以男希聲為帥，故有是命。

translations.literal: At the time Hunan Ma Yin memorialized long illness unfit for military affairs and asked that his son Xisheng be made commander—hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Hunan Ma Yin reported long illness unfit for command and asked his son Xisheng be made commander—hence the order.

sentences.zh: 中書奏：「吏部流內銓諸色選人，所試判兩節，欲委定其等第，文優者超一資，其次者次資，又次者以同類，道理全疏者於同類中少人戶處注擬。

translations.literal: The Central Secretariat memorialized: "Among all candidate types at the Board of Appointments inner selection, the examination requires two stanzas of judgment; we ask to fix grades: superior writing advances one rank; next, one step lower; next again, same class; wholly deficient reasoning should be appointed within the same class at posts with fewer candidates.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat said: "Inner selection candidates of all types take a two-stanza judgment examination; we ask to fix grades—superior writing advances one rank, next one step lower, next same class, and wholly deficient reasoning goes within the same class to posts with fewer candidates.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申朔，帝御文明殿，冊皇子秦王，仗衛樂懸如儀。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, gengshen new moon: the Emperor held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor to invest Prince Qin; guards, music suspended, and ritual as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen new moon of the eleventh month Mingzong at the Hall of Civil Splendor invested Prince Qin; guards and suspended music followed ritual.

sentences.zh: 甲子，正衙命使冊皇子宋王於鎮州。

translations.literal: On jiazi envoys appointed at the main court invested Prince Song at Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi envoys at the main court invested Prince Song at Zhen.

sentences.zh: 是日，幸龍門。

translations.literal: That day he visited Longmen.
translations.idiomatic: That day he visited Longmen.

sentences.zh: 翌日，馮道奏曰：「陛下宮中無事，遊幸近郊則可矣，若涉曆山險，萬一馬足蹉跌，則貽臣下之憂。

translations.literal: The next day Feng Dao memorialized: "When nothing presses at palace, touring the nearby suburbs suffices; if Your Majesty crosses Li Mountain's peril, should a horse stumble, you would trouble your ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Next day Feng Dao said: "When the palace is quiet, touring nearby suburbs suffices; if you cross Li Mountain's peril and a horse stumbles, you will trouble your ministers.

sentences.zh: 臣聞千金之子，坐不垂堂；

translations.literal: I have heard that the son of a thousand gold does not sit with eaves overhead;
translations.idiomatic: I have heard the son of a thousand gold does not sit under eaves;

sentences.zh: 百金之子，立不倚衡。

translations.literal: the son of a hundred gold does not stand leaning on a railing.
translations.idiomatic: the son of a hundred gold does not stand leaning on a railing.

sentences.zh: 況貴為天子，豈可自輕哉！

translations.literal: How much more one exalted as Son of Heaven—how can he make light of himself!
translations.idiomatic: How much more the Son of Heaven—how can he make light of himself!

sentences.zh: 」帝斂容謝之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor composed himself and thanked him.
translations.idiomatic: " Mingzong composed himself and thanked him.

sentences.zh: 退令小黃門至中書問道垂堂、倚衡之義，道因注解以聞，帝深納之。

translations.literal: He retired and sent a junior yellow gate to the Secretariat to ask the meaning of "not sitting under eaves" and "not leaning on a railing"; Dao explained and reported; the Emperor deeply accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: He retired and sent a junior yellow gate to the Secretariat to ask the meaning of not sitting under eaves and not leaning on a railing; Dao explained and reported; Mingzong deeply accepted it.

sentences.zh: 己巳，故太子少保致仕封舜卿贈太子少傅。

translations.literal: On jisi the late retired crown prince junior tutor Feng Shunqing was posthumously made crown prince junior tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the late retired crown prince junior tutor Feng Shunqing was posthumously made crown prince junior tutor.

sentences.zh: 庚午，應州節度使張敬達移雲州，以捧聖都指揮使、守恩州刺史沙彥詢為應州節度使；

translations.literal: On gengwu Ying military commissioner Zhang Jingda was transferred to Yun; Protector Saint commander and En prefect Sha Yanxun was made Ying military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Zhang Jingda of Ying moved to Yun; Sha Yanxun, Protector Saint commander and En prefect, became Ying commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以潁州團練使高行周為安北都護，充振武節度使。

translations.literal: Yingzhou training commissioner Gao Xingzhou was made Protector-General of Pacifying the North and Zhenwu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xingzhou, Yingzhou training commissioner, became Protector-General of Pacifying the North and Zhenwu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬申，黔南節度使楊漢章棄城奔忠州，為董璋所攻也。

translations.literal: On renshen Qiannan military commissioner Yang Hanzhang abandoned his post and fled to Zhong—attacked by Dong Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Yang Hanzhang of Qiannan abandoned his post and fled to Zhong—attacked by Dong Zhang.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，製西川節度使孟知祥削奪官爵，以其同董璋叛也。

translations.literal: On yihai an order stripped Xichuan military commissioner Meng Zhixiang of rank for colluding with Dong Zhang in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an order stripped Xichuan commissioner Meng Zhixiang of rank for colluding with Dong Zhang.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以前同州節度使羅周敬為左監門上將軍。

translations.literal: On bingzi former Tongzhou military commissioner Luo Zhoujing was made Left Gate of Surveillance general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi former Tong commissioner Luo Zhoujing became Left Gate of Surveillance general.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，故兵部侍郎許光義加贈禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On dingchou the late Vice Minister of War Xu Guangyi was further posthumously made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the late Vice Minister of War Xu Guangyi was further posthumously made Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，西面軍前奏，今月十三日，階州刺史王宏贄、瀘州刺史馮暉，自利州取山路出劍門關外倒下，殺敗董璋守關兵士三千餘人，收復劍州。

translations.literal: On xinsi the western-front army reported: on the thirteenth of this month Jie prefect Wang Hongzan and Lu prefect Feng Hui, from Li by a mountain path outside Jianmen Pass, came down upon Dong Zhang's garrison of more than three thousand and recovered Jian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the western front reported: on the thirteenth Jie prefect Wang Hongzan and Lu prefect Feng Hui, from Li by a mountain path outside Jianmen Pass, struck Dong Zhang's garrison of more than three thousand and recovered Jian.

sentences.zh: 甲申，日南至，帝御文明殿受朝賀。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the winter solstice, the Emperor held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor to receive congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the winter solstice, Mingzong held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor for congratulation.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以給事中鄭韜光為左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: On bingxu Supervising Secretariat drafter Zheng Taoguang was made Left Regular Attendant at Court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zheng Taoguang, supervising secretariat drafter, became Left Regular Attendant at Court.

sentences.zh: 青州奏，得登州狀，契丹阿保機男東丹王突欲越海來歸國。

translations.literal: Qingzhou reported receiving notice from Deng prefecture: Khitan Abaoji's son, Eastern Dan prince Yelü Bei, crossed the sea to return to the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: Qing reported notice from Deng: Khitan Abaoji's son, Eastern Dan prince Yelü Bei, crossed the sea to return to the dynasty.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《契丹國志》：時東丹王失職怨望，因率其部四十餘人越海歸唐。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Khitan State Annals》: At the time the Eastern Dan prince, displaced and resentful, led more than forty of his followers across the sea to return to Tang.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Khitan State Annals》 says the Eastern Dan prince, displaced and resentful, led more than forty followers across the sea to Tang.)〉

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，荊南奏，湖南節度使、楚國王馬殷薨，廢朝三日。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yiwei: Jingnan reported that Hunan military commissioner and King of Chu Ma Yin had died; court was suspended three days.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the twelfth month Jingnan reported Hunan commissioner and King of Chu Ma Yin had died; court was suspended three days.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以前襄州節度使安元信為宋州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengzi former Xiangzhou military commissioner An Yuanxin was made Song military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi former Xiang commissioner An Yuanxin became Song commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，幸苑中。

translations.literal: On xinchou he visited the park.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he visited the park.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以二王後秘書丞、襲酅國公楊仁矩卒輟朝，贈工部郎中。

translations.literal: On dingwei Yang Renju, Secretariat aide and heir of the two dynasties and Duke of E, died; court was suspended; he was posthumously made Master of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Yang Renju, secretariat aide and heir of the two dynasties and Duke of E, died; court was suspended; he was posthumously made Master of Works.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，湖南節度使馬希聲起復，加兼中書令。

translations.literal: On gengxu Hunan military commissioner Ma Xisheng left mourning and returned to office, additionally palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Hunan commissioner Ma Xisheng left mourning and returned to office, additionally palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以樞密院直學士、戶部侍郎閻至為澤州刺史；

translations.literal: On renzi Privy Academy direct academician and Vice Minister of Revenue Yan Zhi was made Ze prefect;
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Yan Zhi, privy academy direct academician and vice minister of revenue, became Ze prefect;

sentences.zh: 樞密使直學士、戶部侍郎史圭為貝州刺史。

translations.literal: Privy Commissioner direct academician and Vice Minister of Revenue Shi Gui was made Bei prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Gui, privy commissioner direct academician and vice minister of revenue, became Bei prefect.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣樞密使安重誨赴西面軍前。

translations.literal: On jiayin Privy Commissioner An Chonghui was sent to the western-front army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin An Chonghui was sent to the western front.

sentences.zh: 時帝以蜀路險阻，進兵艱難，潼關已西，物價甚賤，百姓挽運至利州，率一斛不得一斗，謂侍臣曰：「關西勞擾，未有成功，誰能辦吾事者！

translations.literal: At the time the Emperor, because the Shu road was perilous and advance difficult and west of Tong Pass goods were very cheap yet the people hauling to Li prefecture got only one dou per hu, said to attendants: "West of the Pass the labor is exhausting and success nowhere—who can manage my affairs!
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong, finding the Shu road perilous and advance hard and west of Tong Pass goods cheap yet haulers to Li getting only one dou per hu, told attendants: "West of the Pass the labor is crushing and success nowhere—who can manage this for me!

sentences.zh: 朕須自行。

translations.literal: I must go myself.
translations.idiomatic: I must go myself.

sentences.zh: 」安重誨曰：「此臣之責也，臣請行。

translations.literal: An Chonghui said: "This is your servant's duty; your servant asks to go.
translations.idiomatic: An Chonghui said: "This is my duty; I ask to go.

sentences.zh: 」帝許之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Mingzong approved.

sentences.zh: 言訖而辭，翌日遂行。

translations.literal: When he had finished speaking he took leave; the next day he set out.
translations.idiomatic: When he had finished he took leave; the next day he set out.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，故西川兵馬都監、泗州防禦使李嚴贈太傅。

translations.literal: On jiayin the late Xichuan army-and-horse overseer and Sizhou defense commissioner Li Yan was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the late Xichuan army overseer and Sizhou defender Li Yan was posthumously made grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，車駕畋於西山，臘也。

translations.literal: On bingchen the imperial carriage hunted at Western Hill—it was the La hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Mingzong hunted at Western Hill—the La hunt.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，回鶻遣使來朝貢。

translations.literal: On dingsi the Uighurs sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Uighur envoys came to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊午，故荊南節度使、檢校太尉、兼尚書令、南平王高季興贈太尉。

translations.literal: On wuwu the late Jingnan military commissioner, honorary grand preceptor, concurrent Minister of Personnel, and King of Nanping Gao Jixing was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the late Jingnan commissioner, honorary grand preceptor, concurrent minister of personnel, and King of Nanping Gao Jixing was posthumously made grand preceptor.
